definitions.full: H519. amah אָמָה noun feminine maid, handmaid (Phoenician אמת , Arabic , Sabean אמת in proper name SabDenkm 20 , Aramaic , Assyrian amtu Zim BP 67 ) — ׳א absolute Gen 21:10 +; suffix אֲמָתִי 30:3 +, etc.; plural absolute אֲמָהֹת 31:33 ; 2Sam 6:22 ; construct אַמְהוֺת 6:20 ; אַמְהֹתַי Job 19:5 etc. — maid, handmaid . 1 literally maidservant (= שִׁפְחָה q. v., where however sometimes more servile; rarely P in Hexateuch) Gen 30:3 ; 31:33 (|| שִׁפְחָה 29:24 , 29 ; P 30:4 f. J etc.) Exod 2:5 (all E); 2Sam 6:20 , 22 ; Job 19:15 ; Nahum 2:8 (suffix refers to mistress, except Job 19:15 compare 2Sam 6:20 , 22 ); in legisl. (|| עֶבֶד ) Exod 20:10 , 17 ; 21:20 , 26 , 27 , 32 (all E) Lev 25:6 , 44 (twice in verse) (H) Deut 5:14 (twice in verse); 5:18 ; 12:12 , 18 ; 15:17 (compare see 12) 16:11 , 14 ; compare also Job 31:13 ; Ezra 2:65 ; Neh 7:67 ; applied to concubine (suffix of master) Gen 20:17 ; 21:12 ; Exod 23:12 (all E) Judg 9:18 ; 19:19 ; also Gen 21:10 (twice in verse); 21:13 ( 16:1 f. P שִׁפְחָה q. v.) Exod 21:7 (all E), see on this Sta Gesch i: p. 380. 2 figurative in address, אֲמָֽתְךָ etc., referring to speaker, in token of humility; Ruth 3:9 (twice in verse) (|| שׁפחה 2:13 ) 1Sam 1:16 (|| id. 1:18 ) 25:24 (twice in verse); 25:25 , 28 , 31 , 41 (|| id. 25:27 ) 2Sam 14:15-16 , (|| id. 14:6 ; 14:7 ; 14:12 ; 14:15 ; 14:17 ; 14:19 ); 20:17 ; 1Kin 1:13 , 17 ; 3:20 ; in addressing God (never שׁפחה ) 1Sam 1:11 (3 t. in verse), compare ׳בֶּןאֿ Psa 86:16 ; 116:16 .
